intent: Answer whether an available catalog product exists in the Ajax 'Eco Classic 25C-DXE' Cleaning Liquid line with cleaner_type=degreaser.
success_criteria: SQL matches product_variants on brand='Ajax', series='Eco Classic', model='25C-DXE'
Match restricted to variants whose cleaner_type property equals 'degreaser'
Availability filtered via store_inventory.available_today_quantity > 0; unavailable variants excluded from the answer
refs contain the record_path of each available matched product (runtime placeholder)

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path, pk.product_kind_name, COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity),0) AS total_available FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :cleaner_type JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model AND pk.product_kind_name = :product_kind_name GROUP BY pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path, pk.product_kind_name;

SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path, COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity),0) AS total_available FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :cleaner_type JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model AND pk.product_kind_name = :product_kind_name GROUP BY pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path HAVING total_available > 0;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: {'<YES>' if available else '<NO>'} — {('Yes, the Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid with cleaner type degreaser is carried and available: ' + ', '.join(r['product_name'] + ' (' + r['record_path'] + ')' for r in available)) if available else 'No available product matches the Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid line with cleaner type degreaser.'}
